evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: As TDMs are more consistent and 37 times cheaper than 2026 LLM judges, our results suggest they can be attractive judges if their biases are tested for the task.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Emotional tone affects them most, and rewriting the better answer in such a tone lowers the accuracy of a typical TDM from 99% to 42%.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability for each allowed answer instead of generating text, which makes them candidates for cheaply replacing LLM judges that compare two answers.
